sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:60

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:60:1
items.html: Beria ascends to the world of Atzilut, then Beria decrees Beria to be Atzilut. This is very simple, for there is no matter of imagined places here, but rather a matter of quality, of rank. When you say that the lower one rose to the place of the upper one, its meaning is that its form became equal to that of the upper one. If so, it is necessarily the case that when Beria rises to the world of Atzilut, it then becomes actual Atzilut. And remember this for all places.
